method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: Original Supports interpreted supporters; rocking boat metaphor challenge status quo.
Rumor mill metaphor rumor production; refugee counts original retained.
Emphasis before intact; Trump prewar opposition is disputed candidate claim, not independently resolved by translation.
Authorization distinct from war declaration, missing original with repaired only Chinese grammar; political defense of invasion retained.
Safe zone not automatically no-fly zone; avoid adding military enforcement powers.
Obama coalition electorate, not formal coalition government.
Hannity reported private conversation not evidence Trump made requested prewar public statement.
Advisor says might factual not certifying all Iraq claims.
Annual deficit flow distinct from accumulated national debt stock.
Rust Belt industrial region, not geographic state or literal rusty belt.

revisions.source: After days of Trump's "grab them by the pussy" comments dominating the news, the story begins to move on to other things, not the least of which is these leaks.
revisions.zh: 特朗普“抓她们的阴部”的言论占据新闻数日后，报道开始转向其他事情，其中这些泄露材料尤其引人注目。

revisions.source: After a few days, Comey does announce that no new evidence was found. Unfortunately for you, there was a definite effect on the polls as early voting began.
revisions.zh: 几天后，科米确实宣布，没有发现新证据。对你不利的是，在提前投票开始时，这件事已明显影响了民调。

revisions.source: It's not hard to notice your progressive emphasis with this answer.
revisions.zh: 这个回答鲜明地体现了你对进步派立场的强调。

revisions.source: Fighting for the rebirth of a public option is a mainstream position for the Democrats.
revisions.zh: 争取恢复公共医保选项，是民主党的主流立场。

revisions.source: Supports and opponents both note that you are not really rocking the boat on this issue.
revisions.zh: 支持者与反对者都注意到，在这个问题上，你并没有真正打破现状。

revisions.source: It may have been an off-the-cuff statement, but it has erupted onto the headlines, likely to your detriment.
revisions.zh: 这也许只是随口的一句话，却突然登上头条，很可能对你不利。

revisions.source: Whatever else people can say about this campaign, it certainly hasn't lacked in verbal combat between you and Mr. Trump.
revisions.zh: 不管人们还能如何评价这场竞选，它肯定不缺少你与特朗普先生之间的唇枪舌剑。

revisions.source: Behind the scenes, Obama is not too pleased with your lukewarm stance. One way or another, rumors of a rift leak into the political press.
revisions.zh: 私下里，奥巴马对你不冷不热的立场很不高兴。不知通过什么途径，你们之间有裂痕的传闻流进了政治新闻媒体。

revisions.source: Your talk about an “appallingly low” level and “millions” of refugees immediately starts the right-wing rumor mill churning about your refugee plans.
revisions.zh: 你说接收人数“低得令人震惊”，又提到“数百万”难民，立刻让右翼开始对你的难民计划大肆编造传闻。

revisions.source: Some of your supporters are upset that you aren't taking a stronger stand on admitting Syrian refugees.
revisions.zh: 你的一些支持者很不满，认为你在接收叙利亚难民上没有采取更强硬的支持立场。

revisions.source: Some critics are saying that Cory Booker's resume is a little thin to be named as your running mate, and that you are dangerously close to pandering. What is your response?
revisions.zh: 一些批评者认为，科里·布克资历尚浅，担任你的竞选搭档还不够，而且你已经危险地接近刻意讨好特定选民。你会如何回应？

revisions.source: What is your position on the Trans-Pacific Partnership? Would you pursue further trade agreements as President?
revisions.zh: 你对跨太平洋伙伴关系协定有什么立场？担任总统后，你是否会推动更多贸易协议？

revisions.source: Cory Booker and I will both fight to ensure that all Americans have health care, economic security, and acess to clean water. I'm proud to name him as my running mate.
revisions.zh: 科里·布克和我都会努力，确保所有美国人拥有医疗保障、经济安全和清洁用水。我很自豪能请他担任我的搭档。

revisions.source: Cory Booker has been a tireless advocate on behalf of the people of New Jersey, and on behalf of African-Americans everywhere. He will make sure that all groups have the voice they deserve in my Administration.
revisions.zh: 科里·布克一直不知疲倦地为新泽西州人民，以及各地的非裔美国人发声。他会确保在我的政府中，所有群体都拥有应有的发言权。

revisions.source: Cory Booker really impressed me with his thoughtfulness, intelligence, experience, and ability to step in at a moment's notice, should the situation demand it.
revisions.zh: 科里·布克深思熟虑、聪慧，有经验，而且能在情况需要时随时接任。这些都给我留下了深刻印象。

revisions.source: Donald Trump's actions and comments about women are reprehensible. It would be asburd of us not to bring that up as we campaign, along with other important issues.
revisions.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普针对女性的行为和言论应受谴责。竞选时，我们如果不把这件事与其他重要议题一起提出来，那就太荒谬了。

revisions.source: The level of disruption from globalization has simply been too much for American workers over the past few years. I don't support TPP, and there will be a pause on any new trade deals during my Presidency.
revisions.zh: 过去几年，全球化给美国劳动者带来的冲击，实在过于严重。我不支持跨太平洋伙伴关系协定，担任总统期间，也会暂停任何新的贸易协议。

revisions.source: I was a supporter of this deal at first, but I'm very disappointed to see some of the provisions that made it into the final version. I unfortunately cannot support the TPP at this point.
revisions.zh: 我起初支持这项协议，但看到最终版本纳入的一些条款，感到非常失望。很遗憾，目前我不能支持跨太平洋伙伴关系协定。

revisions.source: As it stands, this deal is a step in the right direction, but I have some real concerns as well. We're going to seriously reevaluate this deal when I'm in office, and work to renegotiate certain aspects of it.
revisions.zh: 就目前而言，这项协议是朝正确方向迈出的一步，但我也有一些实质性担忧。上任后，我们会认真重新评估它，并努力就某些内容重新谈判。

revisions.source: The TPP is a key piece of our battle against excessive Chinese influence in Asia, and it will lead to greater economic growth here in the United States. I support Barack Obama's efforts to pass this deal.
revisions.zh: 跨太平洋伙伴关系协定，是我们遏制中国在亚洲过大影响力的一项关键措施，也会促进美国的经济增长。我支持贝拉克·奥巴马推动通过这项协议的努力。

revisions.source: I think it's obvious that we plan to spend a lot of time campaigning with Bernie Sanders, and that we're making a real effort to incorporate his message into our campaign.
revisions.zh: 我想，很明显，我们计划花很多时间与伯尼·桑德斯共同竞选，也在认真努力，把他的主张融入我们的竞选。

revisions.source: I want us to do a high-profile appearance with Bernie in Michigan, once the campaign gets going. We don't agree on every issue, but I want to embrace his economic message and show people that our party is unified.
revisions.zh: 竞选展开后，我希望我们与伯尼在密歇根州高调共同亮相。我们并非在每个议题上都一致，但我想接受他的经济主张，让大家看到本党的团结。

revisions.source: Bernie Sanders has offered to campaign extensively on our behalf, and of course we want to have him on the trail. I'm willing to make a few small promises to make that happen.
revisions.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯提出愿意广泛为我们助选，我们当然希望他加入竞选活动。我愿意作出几项小承诺，来促成这件事。

revisions.source: I'd love to have Bernie Sanders out there campaigning for us, but the things he is asking for are simply unrealistic. I'm not going to sit here and bargain away my platform when I'm the one who won the nomination.
revisions.zh: 我很希望伯尼·桑德斯出来为我们助选，但他提出的要求实在不切实际。赢得提名的是我，我不会坐在这里，拿自己的政纲讨价还价。

revisions.source: Donald Trump is lying when says he opposed the war. I challenge him to produce a single public statement that he made before the Iraq War started -- as opposed to years after the fact.
revisions.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普说自己反对过战争，是在撒谎。我要求他拿出哪怕一份自己在伊拉克战争开始之前发表的公开言论，而不是事后多年才说的话。

revisions.source: Donald Trump has shown an alarming lack of knowledge about even the basics of U.S. foreign policy. He would set us back many, many years on our objectives in Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and elsewhere.
revisions.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普连美国外交最基本的情况都不了解，令人忧虑。他会让我们在欧洲、亚洲、中东等地的目标倒退很多很多年。

revisions.source: If I knew what I know now, I wouldn't have voted "yes". But real culprit of this war was George Bush and the Republicans, using faulty intelligence.
revisions.zh: 如果当时知道我如今知道的情况，我就不会投赞成票。但真正酿成这场战争的，是乔治·布什和共和党人，他们使用了错误情报。

revisions.source: My vote in favor of this authorization was one of the toughest of my career. And I will admit, the war didn't go as well as Bush promised it would. But ultimately, we removed a murderous dictator and replaced him a parliamentary democracy.
revisions.zh: 投票赞成这项授权，是我整个政治生涯中最艰难的决定之一。我承认，战争进展并不像布什承诺的那样顺利。但最终，我们推翻了一位残暴的独裁者，建立了议会民主制度。

revisions.source: I will stand behind the "red lines" that we have set, and I will take vigorous action to defend the Syrian people against Assad, Russia, Iran, ISIS, and other malevolent influences.
revisions.zh: 我会坚持我们划下的“红线”，积极采取行动，保护叙利亚人民，使他们免受阿萨德、俄罗斯、伊朗、“伊斯兰国”及其他恶意势力的侵害。

revisions.source: There are no good options in Syria. We need to continue our support for the moderate rebels, and we need to defeat ISIS wherever they appear. I also support extensive aid and funding to countries that are bearing the brunt of the refugee problem.
revisions.zh: 在叙利亚，没有什么好选择。我们需要继续支持温和派反对武装，并在“伊斯兰国”出现的任何地方击败它。我也支持向承受难民问题主要压力的国家提供广泛的援助和资金。

revisions.source: Unfortunately, we are limited in what we can reasonably do in Syria. I support the creation of a safe zone in Syria, for opponents of ISIS and the Assad regime, that we will defend and provide aid to. Hopefully this can limit the humanitarian damage and refugee flows.
revisions.zh: 不幸的是，我们在叙利亚能够合理采取的行动有限。我支持在叙利亚设立安全区，供反对“伊斯兰国”和阿萨德政权的人使用，由我们保护并提供援助。希望这能减少人道灾难和难民外流。

revisions.source: Victory in the Syrian Civil War for moderate rebel forces is an impossibility. We need to use our strength to negotiate a peace settlement that will protect their interests and lives, and get our troops out.
revisions.zh: 温和派反对武装不可能赢得叙利亚内战。我们需要运用自己的实力，谈成一项和平协议，保护他们的利益和生命，并撤出我们的部队。

revisions.source: We take the issues affecting minority communities very seriously. We're going to push for police reform, clean water, economic justice, and we're going to denounce Trump's dangerous and hateful rhetoric.
revisions.zh: 我们非常认真地对待影响少数族群的问题。我们会推动警务改革、清洁用水和经济公正，也会谴责特朗普危险而充满仇恨的言论。

revisions.source: Cory Booker has more experience in public service than Donald Trump by a mile. He is a sitting U.S. Senator. Any insinuation that he somehow isn't qualified is simply a phony attack by the right-wing outrage machine.
revisions.zh: 科里·布克的公共服务经验，远远超过唐纳德·特朗普。他是现任美国参议员。任何暗示他不够资格的说法，都不过是右翼煽愤机器的虚假攻击。

revisions.source: Pundits speculate on your attempts to recreate the "Obama coalition" with your running-mate.
revisions.zh: 评论人士猜测，你正试图通过搭档人选重建“奥巴马选民联盟”。

revisions.source: While some say this is yet another changed position on your part, it could help mend fences with the left of your party.
revisions.zh: 虽然有人说，你又一次改变了立场，但这可能有助于修复你与党内左翼的关系。

revisions.source: There are pros and cons to embracing Bernie so closely.
revisions.zh: 如此密切地拥抱伯尼，有利也有弊。

revisions.source: Who knows if it means anything nationally, but a raucous crowd turned out to support the two of you.
revisions.zh: 谁知道这在全国层面是否有意义，不过，一大群热烈的群众到场支持你们两人。

revisions.source: The reluctance of Bernie to endorse you after a couple of personal meetings fuels rampant speculation about the causes.
revisions.zh: 几次私下会面后，伯尼仍不愿背书支持你，外界对原因的猜测因而四起。

revisions.source: Television commentator Sean Hannity recounts a single, private conversation between himself and Trump in 2003 where Trump said he opposed the war.
revisions.zh: 电视评论员肖恩·汉尼提回忆了一次2003年与特朗普的私下谈话，据他所说，特朗普当时表示反对战争。

revisions.source: “Clinton defends Iraq War” is the headline today. Your statement might be factually accurate, but it's out of step with the views of most in your party.
revisions.zh: 今天的头条是“克林顿为伊拉克战争辩护”。你的说法也许在事实层面准确，却与党内大多数人的观点不合。

revisions.source: Most respected economists are highly critical of trade restrictions and protectionism, yet your running-mate is well known for espousing these positions. Is that something you also embrace?
revisions.zh: 大多数受尊重的经济学家都严厉批评贸易限制和保护主义，但你的搭档以支持这些立场著称。你是否也认同？

revisions.source: Sherrod Brown is serious about ensuring that all workers are well paid, and protected from the impact of unfair trade deals. We're going to give him a significant voice in my Administration.
revisions.zh: 谢罗德·布朗认真致力于确保所有劳动者获得良好报酬，并免受不公平贸易协议的冲击。我们会让他在我的政府中发挥重要作用。

revisions.source: Sherrod Brown has served his home state of Ohio for most of his life, fighting for workers and everyday people. He has won numerous statewide elections there as well.
revisions.zh: 谢罗德·布朗大半生都在服务家乡俄亥俄州，为劳动者和普通民众奋斗。他也在那里多次赢得全州范围的选举。

revisions.source: Sherrod Brown has served as a Congressman and Senator for over 20 years, tirelessly advocating for the American people. He has the experience and qualifications that we need in our Administration.
revisions.zh: 谢罗德·布朗担任众议员和参议员二十多年，一直不知疲倦地为美国人民发声。他拥有我们政府所需要的经验和资格。

revisions.source: The fact of the matter is, the deficit just isn't as important as some people make it out to be. If every person has access to a quality education and reliable health care, the economy will grow enough over time to make the deficit a non-issue.
revisions.zh: 事实是，赤字并没有一些人说得那么重要。如果每个人都能接受优质教育，拥有可靠的医疗保障，经济就会随着时间充分增长，让赤字不再成问题。

revisions.source: Republicans rave about the deficit when a Democrat is President. But when it's time to cut taxes for the top 1%, suddenly it's not an issue any more. I wonder why that is?
revisions.zh: 民主党人当总统时，共和党人大谈赤字；可一到给最富有的1%人群减税的时候，赤字突然又不算问题了。不知道这是为什么？

revisions.source: Republican tax cuts from Reagan and Bush have driven the fiscal condition of this country into a dire condition. Now Donald Trump says he wants to cut taxes for the rich even more.
revisions.zh: 里根和布什的共和党减税政策，把这个国家的财政推入了严峻境地。现在，唐纳德·特朗普又说，要进一步为富人减税。

revisions.source: We need to make the tough choices that will get our sprawling deficit under control. I will increase taxes on the 1% and continue the significant progress that Barack Obama has made in reducing our annual deficit.
revisions.zh: 我们需要作出艰难选择，控制不断膨胀的赤字。我会向最富有的1%人群增税，并延续贝拉克·奥巴马在减少年度赤字上取得的重大进展。

revisions.source: In a perfect world, with fair trade, then more trade is always better. But we cannot be blind to the fact that China and other countries are cheating and ignoring many provisions of our trade deals, and deeply harming American workers in the process.
revisions.zh: 在一个实行公平贸易的理想世界里，贸易总是越多越好。但我们不能无视：中国等国正在作弊，漠视贸易协议中的许多条款，并在这个过程中严重伤害美国劳动者。

revisions.source: Sherrod Brown also happens to be a deeply qualified Senator with extensive experience in government. And we must admit that the current system isn't working for places like Ohio, Pennsylvania, Michigan, and others.
revisions.zh: 谢罗德·布朗同时还是一位资格充分、政府经验丰富的参议员。我们必须承认，现行体制对俄亥俄州、宾夕法尼亚州、密歇根州等地并不奏效。

revisions.source: Pundits note that Sherrod Brown is a surprisingly populist choice, and immediately focus on the implications for the rust belt.
revisions.zh: 评论人士注意到，选择谢罗德·布朗出人意料地带有民粹主义色彩，立即开始关注这对铁锈地带的影响。

revisions.source: Pundits note that Sherrod Brown is a surprisingly populist choice, and immediately focus on the implications for Ohio and the rust belt.
revisions.zh: 评论人士注意到，选择谢罗德·布朗出人意料地带有民粹主义色彩，立即开始关注这对俄亥俄州及铁锈地带的影响。

revisions.source: Some mainstream economists question your logic on this issue, but this position plays well on the left.
revisions.zh: 一些主流经济学家质疑你在这个问题上的逻辑，但这个立场很受左翼欢迎。

revisions.source: Right-wing media spins your promise to raise taxes. The left is concerned about what exactly your "tough choices" will be.
revisions.zh: 右翼媒体对你增税的承诺大做文章。左翼则担心，你所谓的“艰难选择”到底是什么。

revisions.source: What was your rationale behind selecting Bernie Sanders as your running mate?
revisions.zh: 你选择伯尼·桑德斯作为竞选搭档的理由是什么？

revisions.source: Some of your most ardent supporters, including some major donors, are wondering about your judgment in selecting Bernie Sanders as a running mate. Can you say something to reassure them?
revisions.zh: 你一些最热忱的支持者，包括一些大金主，对你选择伯尼·桑德斯作为搭档的判断有所疑虑。你能说些什么，让他们安心？

revisions.source: Bernie Sanders is going to be a very active part of my Administration. We both want what's best for this country and his input will be taken very seriously.
revisions.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯会在我的政府中发挥非常积极的作用。我们都希望这个国家得到最好的发展，会非常认真地听取他的意见。

revisions.source: The differences between us are much smaller than the things that unite us. We both wake up every day and fight for average Americans -- for their health care, their housing and education costs, and their personal rights.
revisions.zh: 我们之间的分歧，远远小于把我们团结起来的共同点。我们每天醒来，都为普通美国人奋斗，为他们的医疗、住房与教育费用，以及个人权利奋斗。

revisions.source: During the past few months, our party has spoken, and we can't deny that Bernie Sanders enjoys a huge amount of support. It's only right that we join forces, and together prevent any possibility of a Trump Administration.
revisions.zh: 过去几个月，我们党已经表达了意见。我们不能否认，伯尼·桑德斯获得了大量支持。我们理应携手，彻底阻止特朗普政府出现的可能。
